appraisal.rule: seed = ready + dead + invalid (kit county-ingest-run section 8)

link_pass_anchor_parcels.note: a parcel without a permit anchor falls back to the built year (low confidence) or to no age; the anchor-eligible permits that stay unlinked sit on parcels no public source names, so at most that many more parcels fall back because of them

limitations.detail: BBB returns a bot challenge and 403 to scripted access; ratings ship as rating null, status blocked, until approved API access (decisions.md section 4)

the Austin export covers Austin (full purpose and ETJ) and the cities whose permits it carries; unincorporated Travis and the other cities are not in it, so a property outside that scope shows no permit history
the 22 jurisdictions other than Austin stay blocked or custodian-only as classified (travis-sources.yaml)
103,869 Austin permits on Williamson County parcels (tcad_id printed as a Williamson CAD account): outside Travis, left out of the Travis permit totals (decisions.md section 25.6)

251,888 permits: 63,019 with a blank tcad_id and 188,869 on geo_ids no 2026 account prints that TCAD's permit listing does not attribute to one current account; loaded internally, linked to no property (decisions.md section 25.10)

7,531 permits on retired geo_ids are linked through TCAD's own permit listing (match_method tcad_permit_listing, confidence official_listing); a roof-age anchor from one carries the caveat anchor_link_tcad_permit_listing (3,086 parcels)
38,249 permits on geo_ids shared by several accounts (mostly condominium regimes): linked to no one property
35,457 roofing permits (780 open, 1,080 stalled) are loaded internally and counted but shown on no property
the status is the daily export's value with its capture time; open roofing permits are not refreshed from the permit's live page in v1
447 permits carry a status outside the profile's mapping (needs_review): left out of the open, stalled and closed counts
the seven applicant fields are personal contact fields and are not collected (T1 privacy classification, decisions.md 25.8)
Texas issues no roofing license, and historical license qualification (which license holder backed which business on a permit's date) is closed for v1 (decisions.md section 23)
68,442 accounts have no polygon of their own on the TNR layer (condominium units and recent splits): no parcel coordinates, never geocoded
geometry.polygon holds one ring: the inner rings of 284 parcels (605 rings) are not written (lexicon gap, counted in each parcel's sidecar)

special-district taxable values, per-entity exemptions, an account-wide taxable value, the improvement type as a property form or building count, and an exterior-wall attribute (not printed) have no faithful lexicon member and are not written
no archive field names the county: address.county_name is omitted until lexicon#194; the Atlas page, the run record and the manifest name it (decisions.md section 22)

237,531 parcels have permit history (partial: one jurisdiction's system); 204,393 have none in the export (history_unknown); 281,410 roof ages fall back to the built year (low confidence) and 51,714 parcels have no age
